task: How did QQQ perform versus SPY in months when US 10-year yields rose sharply, fell sharply or stayed fairly flat during 2016–2025?
context: US 10-year nominal constant-maturity Treasury yields (Fed H.15 definition) and dividend-inclusive QQQ/SPY returns.
Calendar months January 2016–December 2025, with December 2015 as the baseline; align yields to the last equity session of each month.
Rising means a same-month yield increase of at least 25 bp; falling means a decrease of at least 25 bp; otherwise flat. This is a descriptive comparison, not a trading signal.

outputs.name: rate_regimes
outputs.description: Three labelled regime rows; the row index is a category, not a date.

schema.name: regime
schema.description: yields_up_25bp, yields_down_25bp or other; in that order.

schema.name: month_count
schema.description: Number of complete paired calendar months in the regime.

schema.name: qqq_mean_return
schema.description: Arithmetic mean of QQQ monthly total returns in the regime.

schema.name: qqq_median_return
schema.description: Median QQQ monthly total return in the regime.

schema.name: qqq_worst_return
schema.description: Minimum QQQ monthly total return in the regime.

schema.name: spy_mean_return
schema.description: Arithmetic mean of SPY monthly total returns in the regime.

schema.name: spy_median_return
schema.description: Median SPY monthly total return in the regime.

schema.name: spy_worst_return
schema.description: Minimum SPY monthly total return in the regime.

schema.name: active_mean_return
schema.description: Mean of paired QQQ minus SPY monthly returns.

schema.name: active_median_return
schema.description: Median of paired QQQ minus SPY monthly returns; not the difference between marginal medians.

schema.name: active_worst_return
schema.description: Minimum of paired QQQ minus SPY monthly returns.

outputs.name: macro_assessment
outputs.instructions: Write at most 180 words for the desk. Describe the observed QQQ versus SPY relationship and sample sizes without claiming causation or a predictive strategy. State actual source, total-return basis, complete/missing months and alignment policy. Do not repeat the table as prose or create another Markdown table.
